tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List the AI members of this Bordet boardroom (name, role, model, capabilities).

tools.name: get_project_state
tools.description: The room's curated living memory: objective, status, constraints, active focus, open questions.

tools.name: get_decisions
tools.description: The room's append-only decisions log (newest first). Check this before re-debating anything.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Semantic search over the room's long-term memory facts.

tools.name: get_recent_messages
tools.description: The last messages in the room's main thread (who said what, when; images noted). Use it on connect to catch up on what the curated state doesn't carry yet, and `before` to page back.

tools.name: ask_member
tools.description: Ask one board member by name (e.g. 'Critic'). The reply is persisted in the room and remembered.

tools.name: ask_room
tools.description: Ask the boardroom: members reply in parallel with independent takes (capped at 3 members per call; pass 'members' to pick which).

tools.name: log_decision
tools.description: Append a decision to the room's log. It lands UNCONFIRMED; the human confirms it in the room.

tools.name: declare_seat
tools.description: Declare yourself as a seat in this boardroom: a name the room addresses you by, kind (assistant | coding_agent), the repo/folder you work in, and a few capabilities. Idempotent; call on connect.

tools.name: await_mention
tools.description: Long-poll (up to 50s) for messages addressed to your seat (@<your name>, @everyone, or a member handing you work). Returns immediately when something is queued, with the project state and decisions since your cursor. Call it in a loop to stay in the room.

tools.name: post_update
tools.description: Post a message to the room as your seat: progress, a result (what changed, where, how to verify), or a question for the humans. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_recent_messages, post_update · Public sink: post_update.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_recent_messages, post_update · Public sink: post_update

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
